## What's new

### Edit Artwork
- New **Edit Artwork…** option in the ••• menu and on long-press.
- **Change the SteamGridDB match:** search SteamGridDB and pick the right game when the automatic match is the wrong version or edition.
- **Pick the images:** choose the exact **Background**, **Cover** and **Logo** from every option SteamGridDB has for that game.
- Your choices are kept, including when artwork is re-downloaded. Removing the SteamGridDB key clears them.

### Home
- **All Games** now uses the same landscape artwork as Continue Playing.
- Only the card you tapped is outlined. The same game is no longer also highlighted in the other row.
- Replaced artwork now refreshes on screen right away.

## Install
Download `Starlight.ipa` below and install it with [Sideloadly](https://sideloadly.io) over your current version, using the same Bundle ID.
